collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — FEARS AND DOUBTS (FEA-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fears big and small, sensible and not, self-doubt, feeling like a fraud, dread with no reason, wanting and fearing the same thing, and courage that is still frightened. Nobody has to be brave, nobody is mocked, and a fear does not have to be conquered by the end.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks a child aged 5-8 and an adult)

collection.description: A child will not let anyone near a wobbly tooth: leave it alone, or tell the story of your own first wobbly tooth.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has a wobbly tooth. It has been wobbly for days. Everybody keeps saying, "Just pull it out!" (subject) won't let anyone near it. (subject.He/she) is sure it'll hurt terribly. (subject.He/she) is eating everything on the other side of (subject.his/her) mouth, very carefully. (friend) sits down beside (subject.him/her).

choices.label: Tell (subject.him/her) About Your First Wobbly Tooth

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: "It'll come out when it's ready," says (friend). "You don't have to do anything." (subject) is enormously relieved. That evening, (subject.he/she) bites into a piece of fruit, forgets, and the tooth just pops out, without hurting at all. (subject.He/she) holds it up in astonishment. "It didn't hurt!" (subject.He/she) is very proud of the tooth.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) tells (subject.him/her) all about (friend.his/her) own first wobbly tooth, which (friend.he/she) kept for weeks out of fear, and which finally came out when (friend.he/she) sneezed. (subject) laughs so much that (subject.his/her) tooth wobbles even more. That night (subject.he/she) sneezes, hopefully, on purpose. It doesn't work. The tooth comes out two days later, on its own.
